headline: McKinsey expects automation to touch 36 million jobs by 2035 and lists ten occupations it could hit hardest, CNBC reports.
score_reason: Lowered from 6: we could only see headlines, so the method, the meaning of 'affect' and the occupations are unverified.
importance_line: Workers in the 10 occupations the report names could be affected, but how many of these jobs would be lost rather than changed is not yet clear.
summary: CNBC reports that a new McKinsey report says automation will affect 36 million jobs by 2035; NewsBytes puts the figures in a US context and adds that more than 40 million jobs could be created.
notes: Headline only: CNBC (403) and NewsBytes (403) could not be opened and no other outlet with text was found. The 'US' and '40 million jobs created' details come from the NewsBytes headline alone.
